decision.reason: Pinned PGlite exposes JavaScript entry points and Wasm modules with custom env imports. Current Rust manifests contain SQLite only. Exact hosting therefore retains JavaScript glue or adds root Cargo dependencies and a compatible host implementation.

compatibilityException.exactRuntimeVersion: @electric-sql/pglite 0.5.4 with its distributed JavaScript glue; Node.js v26.7.0 is the only qualified host
compatibilityException.boundary: Rust Hub process to retained JavaScript PGlite host over a new bounded IPC boundary
compatibilityException.exchangedData: PostgreSQL SQL, bind parameters, result rows, transaction commands, migration commands, errors, and shutdown state
compatibilityException.pilotEvidence: Pinned baseline and retained PGlite host candidate replay 49 historical migrations on darwin/x64; retained evidence covers restart, rollback, ownership, and crash recovery
compatibilityException.securityPackagingRisk: Adds Node.js and npm artifacts, a 25 MB PGlite package, subprocess IPC, filesystem permissions, code-signing scope, updater scope, and supply-chain review
compatibilityException.performanceSupportRisk: Adds process startup, IPC serialization, crash supervision, memory duplication, and support for 121 custom main-module env imports plus 40 initdb env imports
compatibilityException.originalVsCandidateTests: Original PGlite and the retained-host candidate match installed catalog and journal evidence on darwin/x64; SQLite remains rejected as exact engine
compatibilityException.platforms: Retained candidate is qualified only on darwin/x64 with Node.js v26.7.0; iOS, Android, browser, packaged macOS, Windows, and Linux qualification is absent
compatibilityException.removalCondition: Remove retained JavaScript after a Rust-hosted PGlite-compatible engine replays all historical migrations, reopens old state, survives process crashes, and matches embedded and PostgreSQL mutation traces on required platforms
